title: Make Me A Winner - Win £500,000
body:
Make Me A Winner Win £500,000 Tax-Free Cash Terms and Conditions 

These Competition terms and conditions should be read together with, and are in addition to, Bauer Media Group: Competition General Terms & Conditions at: https://www.bauerlegal.co.uk/competition-general-terms-and-conditions (the “General Terms”).  

Together these specific competition terms and conditions and the General Terms shall be referred to as the “Terms”. Where there is a conflict between these terms and the General Terms, these terms shall prevail.

 

ITEM 1: COMPETITION NAME  

Make Me A Winner Win £500,000 tax-free cash running from the Start Date to the End Date as set out below (the “Competition”). 

 

ITEM 2: PROMOTER  

Bauer Radio Limited, registered office: Media House Peterborough Business Park, Lynch Wood, Peterborough, United Kingdom, PE2 6EA and registered under company number 01394141 (the “Promoter”)  

This is a Bauer Media Audio UK Network Competition, running with makemeawinner.co.uk and hellorayo.co.uk. The Competition will be promoted on those websites and on other channels including but not limited to radio stations, SMS, social media, apps, email newsletters and magazines. 

 

ITEM 3: WEBSITE  

The website shall be www.makemeawinner.co.uk (the “Website”) 

 

ITEM 4: COMPETITION START DATE, END DATE AND ENTRY PERIODS  

Entry to the Competition will open and close as follows:  

Competition Start Date: Friday 28 August 2026 at 17:10pm; 

Competition End Date: Friday 11 September 2026 at 17:00pm; 

Online, & Phone Entry Start Date: Friday 28 August 2026 at 17:10pm;
SMS Start Date: Friday 4 September 2026 at 17:10
Online, SMS & Phone Entry End Date: Friday 11 September 2026 at 17:00pm. 

Any entries received before the Start Date or after the End Date (as stated above) will be invalid, but you may still be charged.  

We reserve the right to broadcast the Competition at any time throughout each day during the broadcast schedule.  

Please note that the Competition Entry Period as specified in these Competition terms and conditions are final and are not impacted by the time of broadcast of announcements advertising how to enter the Competition, which may in some circumstances be delayed.

 

ITEM 5: COMPETITION DETAILS  

After the start of the Competition, the prize amount (the “Prize”) will be announced on air. The Prize will be the cash amount that entrants are trying to win.   

We reserve the right to announce the Prize at any time during the Competition. We may also advertise the Prize on any websites and social media channels associated with our stations, via SMS marketing messages and via any other medium, including our third party advertising partners.   

After the Competition has closed, one entrant from all of the valid entries will be selected by automated random draw (the “Draw”).    

If an Entrant fails to answer their phone within 30 seconds, refuses to play, or if any fault occurs immediately prior to or during the call and it is not possible to re-establish contact with the Entrant, they will forfeit their chance to win and another Entrant will be selected at random. The decision of the Production team is final and no correspondence will be entered into.    

The entrant who is randomly selected will win the Prize on offer.   

The entrant selected may be required to talk to the presenter / programming team, and the call may be recorded and played on-air (assuming there is no breach of these terms and conditions). 

 

ITEM 6: ROUTES OF ENTRY, ENTRY LIMITS, AND COSTS  

Entrants are responsible for all costs associated with entering this Competition and Entrants must have permission from the bill payer before entering. Bauer Media is not responsible for any network or technical issues an entrant may experience, which may delay or prevent their participation. 

 

SMS

Entrants may enter between the SMS Entry Start Date and the SMS Entry End Date by sending WIN, CASH, YES, PLAY, ROCK or ENTER to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 65115 or 81215.
Entrants may submit a maximum of 12 SMS entries across the Competition.
Each SMS entry costs £2.50 (from the UK) plus 1 standard network rate message.
 
Entrants may enter between the SMS Entry Start Date and the SMS Entry End Date by sending AMP, GRAB, MEGA, PLUS, OFFER or FIVE to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 65115, 81215 or 82205.
Entrants may submit a maximum of 4 SMS entries across the Competition.
Each SMS entry costs £5.00 (from the UK) plus one standard network rate message. Entrants will receive at least two Competition entries for each valid SMS entry and an automated SMS confirmation from 82205.
 
Entrants may enter between the SMS Entry Start Date and the SMS Entry End Date by sending BANK, DEAL, EXTRA, MAX, MORE or TEN to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 65115, 81215 or 82210.
Entrants may submit a maximum of 4 SMS entries across the Competition.
Each SMS entry costs £10.00 (from the UK) plus one standard network rate message. Entrants will receive at least four Competition entries for each valid SMS entry and an automated SMS confirmation from 82210.
 
SMS messages that do not start with a valid keyword or are not sent to a valid short code will not be entered. SMS entries may be charged outside of any inclusive message bundles and delivery may be delayed at peak times.
 
We may run bonus SMS entry incentives during the Competition. Any incentive will be communicated in the automated SMS confirmation. Where a bonus incentive applies, the entry limit may change.

 

ONLINE  

Entrants can enter the Competition a maximum of 250 times via the Website.  

A single online entry costs £2.50. The use of a debit or credit card may incur charges from your provider.  

We reserve the right to run entry incentives Online throughout the duration of the Competition. These incentives will be communicated via the Website. Where we operate an incentive, the Online entry limit may change.

 

PHONE
Entrants can enter between the Phone Entry Start Date and the Phone Entry End Date up to 250 times in total by calling 0372 376 7519.

From Friday 4 September 2026 at 17:10 Entrants can also enter by calling 03434 156 317, 03434 171 820, 03434 180 109, 03434 195 096, 03434 212 413, 03434 236 852, 03434 269 340, 03434 282 017, 03723 413 840, 0333 131 0160, 03723 807 931, or 03434 121 445. 

Calls (from the UK) are charged at standard network rate. These calls may be charged outside of any inclusive call bundles. We reserve the right to run entry incentives via SMS or Online throughout the duration of the Competition. Where we operate an incentive, the Phone entry limit may change.  

 

RCS (Rich Communication Services)
We may invite Entrants to enter via RCS.
Entrants can enter the Competition a maximum of 50 times via RCS. 
A single RCS entry costs £2.50. The use of a debit or credit card may incur charges from your provider.

 

ITEM 7: ENTRANT RESTRICTIONS  

The Competition is only open to people aged 18 and over who: (i) live in the United Kingdom (excluding Channel Islands and Isle of Man), (ii) are not a Bauer employee or their immediate family (including live-in partner) and (iii) are not an employee of any third-party sponsors or prize providers, or their immediate family (including live-in partner).  

Entrants must enter using a valid UK mobile number.  

All entrants must enter on their own behalf and may not enter on behalf of anyone else.  If we later become aware that the person who played the competition was not the entrant themselves, we will disqualify this entrant and no prize will be payable to any persons involved.

 

ITEM 8: WINNER ANNOUNCEMENT  

Entrants who are randomly selected will be contacted by the phone number provided with their entry. This may be live on air or off-air. Due to programming schedules, this may not be broadcast on all participating radio stations.  

All callers are randomly selected in the same way and any off-air recording will only ever take place after the entries have closed. The name, hometown, photo and any video or audio recording of the winner may also be posted on the Promoter’s Website and / or social media platforms and associated Bauer publications.  

By entering the Competition, the entrant is automatically consenting to being called and having their name and location announced on-air.  

Only one prize can be won throughout the duration of this Competition. Clause 4.12 ("Prize Limits") of the Bauer Media Group Competition General Terms & Conditions shall not apply to the Competition. To be explicit, if you win this competition, you will still be able to enter Make Me A Winner or other competitions on makemeawinner.co.uk moving forwards.

 

ITEM 9: PRIZE DETAILS

The Prize will always be a cash amount that will be delivered to a winner paid in cash, by bank transfer or by cheque.

Delivery or payment of the Prize is subject to the winner providing personal identification and / or proof of address and to internal compliance checks within 14 days of being contacted.

If we are unable to contact a winner to award a prize within 14 days of the Draw date, or if the winner is unable to provide us with personal identification and / or proof of address within 14 days of being contacted, the winner forfeits entirely their right to the prize, and we reserve the right to award this to an alternative winner where possible.

The Prize is non-transferable and cannot be exchanged. Payment of the Prize may take up to 28 days from the point at which the Promoter receives the correct details.

Where, it emerges after the Prize has been awarded that the entrant was in breach of these terms and conditions, we reserve the right to withdraw the Prize from that winner and they will not be entitled to any further reward or remuneration. We reserve the right to exclude individuals who breach our terms and conditions from entering our competitions.

Additional £10,000 draw
The following is only open to Entrants who are over 18, live in Northern Ireland, and enter between 05:10pm on Friday 28 August 2026 and 11:59pm on Wednesday 30 September 2026 via the following routes:
SMS. By sending CASH, ENTER, PLUS, OFFER, MAX or DEAL to 63103
By phone call to 03723 413 840 or 03434 121 445
Online at makemeawinner.co.uk, where the entrant has a postcode beginning BT.

Valid entrants who enter within the entry period specified above will also qualify for this additional draw. Each entrant will receive the same number of entries in the additional draw as they submit to the main “Make Me A Winner” competition.

One entrant from all the valid entries will be selected by automated random draw on Thursday 1 October 2026 and notified by telephone call between 08:30am and 10:00am. The entrant who is randomly selected will win a £10,000 cash prize.

ITEM 10: DATA PROTECTION   

By entering the Competition, entrants are automatically consenting to receiving marketing communications from the Promoter via SMS text message. Entrants can opt out of this at any time by texting: STOP to 61025, 61054, 63103, 64100, 81215, or 65115. This will be charged at 1 standard network rate message. If entrants do not wish to receive any marketing communications, they will need to do this after each time they re-enter the Competition. Entrants’ personal data will (regardless of whether they opt-out) always be used to process their entry. For further information on this, please see our general terms (link below) and our privacy policy at: http://www.bauerdatapromise.co.uk/. 

 

ITEM 11: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND CONSENT  

We will sometimes (at our discretion) telephone entrants and ask them to speak on-air. They have the right to refuse. If they consent, their voice will be recorded and they consent to this recording being used on our radio broadcasts. Entrants agree that we will own this recording and that a copy of it will be stored for further exploitation, which may include promotion.  

Entrants will not be put through to speak on-air if we think they are driving illegally, intoxicated, likely to swear, or otherwise offend our listeners. Whilst on air for the purposes of this competition entrants must not use foul language, swear, say or do anything defamatory or illegal or say or do anything which would damage the reputation of the Promoter, is offensive or inappropriate or which would cause us, or our listeners, harm. Failure to comply will result in disqualification, and if the entrant has won the prize, this will be forfeited.

 

ITEM 12: OTHER CONDITIONS  

We will only accept entries that comply with our terms and conditions, and we may disqualify the entrant if we know or suspect that they have breached them. If the disqualification occurs after a winner has been announced, one further entrant from all the valid entries of that Entry Period will be selected by automated random draw and awarded the Prize.  

All our decisions relating to the Competition and/or awarding of prizes are final. No discussions or correspondence with entrants or any other person will be entered into about the operation of this Competition. We have the right to cancel, amend, terminate, or suspend this Competition if forced to do so due to circumstances outside our control. 

 

ITEM 13: CONTACT DETAILS  

If entrants are having trouble entering our competitions, please check the FAQs here: https://hellorayo.co.uk/competition-faqs/ or here: https://makemeawinner.co.uk/faqs  

Alternatively, write to Bauer Media, 75 Hampstead Road, London, NW1 2PL (please do not send entries to this address). We cannot consider any queries made more than 14 days after the date the winner is announced.
summary:
MAKE ME A WINNER: WIN £500,000 TAX-FREE CASH!

Ready to end the summer in a seriously life-changing way? One guaranteed winner will take home an incredible £500,000 tax-free cash - paid straight into your bank account the very same day!

Just imagine what becoming a half-millionaire could do for the rest of the year and beyond. You could book the holiday of a lifetime, transform your home, treat your family, get ahead before Christmas, or simply enjoy the freedom to make unforgettable memories as summer turns to autumn.

Entries close at 5pm on Friday 11 September, and after the competition closes, Kate Thornton will be making that all-important call. If your phone rings, make sure you answer - because that call could be worth £500,000!

 

Special Offer: Make Me A Winner Over £1 Million Bundle
Boost your chances of winning big with our Make Me A Winner over £1 million bundle. For just £24.99, you unlock 100 entries for £500,000 PLUS 50 entries in our £555,000 competition. Don’t miss out - get ready for two massive chances to win big! ENTER HERE: Make Me A Winner Over £1 Million Bundle


How to Play:
Simply select the number of entries you want before the competition closes at 5pm on Friday 11 September, then keep your phone close.
No code words. No complicated steps. Just enter, answer the call if Kate rings, and you could be celebrating a life-changing win as summer turns to autumn.

Enter now for your chance to win £500,000 tax-free cash and step into the new season as a half-millionaire!
